title: Add internal Rust prefix route model
description: Add canonical RouteTarget and bounded longest-prefix RoutingTable lookup in Rust while preserving all current host APIs and retaining non-/128 DAO wire rejection. DAO rebuild/expiry must preserve internal prefix routes under one MAX_ROUTES budget; returned paths remain egress paths.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical /0,/64,/127,/128 keys and >128 rejection; deterministic LPM and expired fallback; exact host mutation APIs; DAO rebuild preservation; mixed capacity atomicity; all non-/128 wire DAOs still reject without mutation; tests, clippy, and three reviews pass.
notes:
Implemented safe internal Rust prefix model without wire enablement. RouteTarget canonicalizes /0,/64,/127,/128 and rejects >128; RoutingTable uses bounded LPM with O(1) host-only fast path, explicit egress validation, exact host lifecycle APIs, combined MAX_ROUTES accounting, and DAO rebuild preservation. All wire DAO prefixes 0..127 still reject before replay/topology/route mutation. Validation: lichen-rpl 100 unit + 5 integration; lichen-node 157 unit plus doctests; strict scoped Clippy; lichen-rpl no-default check; rustfmt/diff checks; three final reviews no findings.
2026-08-26 Phase-2 completion: preserved the existing bounded RoutingTable and DAO host-only wire policy; made allocation-free RouteTarget available in no_std builds; restored dedicated canonical edge coverage lost during the routing module split. New tests cover /0,/64,/127,/128 canonicalization, >128 rejection, deterministic LPM with expired fallback, exact host mutation, DAO rebuild/expiry preserving prefixes, non-/128 atomic rejection, and one shared 256-route capacity budget. Green: focused prefix_routing 4/4 after rustfmt; full lichen-rpl (207 unit plus integrations/docs); full lichen-node (249 unit plus integrations/docs); lichen-rpl no-default check; strict clippy for no_std lib and std all-targets; targeted rustfmt and git diff checks. No C/Zephyr edits, no Phase-3 review.
close_reason: Completed bounded no_std prefix-route model exposure and canonical LPM/DAO preservation regression coverage; all scoped Rust gates green.
